resolved_items.resolution: The round-trip judge's implication pair resolves the disagreement for the selected source item as written. The formal environment definitionally gives the display-(2.21) one-point infimum, and the theorem characterizes only its finiteness by existence of one of properties (a)--(d). The full printed Definition 2.7.5 additionally assigns the psi_1 norm to the smallest K3 in property 3. That quantitative property-(c) assignment is not entailed by the wrapper and is not definitionally identical to the display-based property-(d) gauge, so Lean-implies-source is no, source-implies-Lean is yes, and the classification is not-faithful-weaker.
resolved_items.primary_evidence: Definition 2.7.5 at PDF page 22/printed page 33 contains both the literal 'smallest K3 in property 3' prose and display (2.21), inf {t > 0 : E exp(|X|/t) <= 2}. Proposition 2.7.1(c) assigns K3 to the all-lambda bound, while (d) assigns K4 to the one-point bound. In the direct dossier, D001/D004 define PsiOneGauge from the one-point admissible scales, D005 is the distinct property-(c) predicate, D007 is property (d), and the target type mentions the gauge only through PsiOneGauge < top. The prepared round-trip constant example separates the numerical quantities: for X = a > 0, the least property-(c) K3 is a, whereas the display infimum is a/log(2).

resolved_items.resolution: The wrapper is acceptable as a display-aligned sub-exponential class-membership/finiteness corollary, but it is not accepted as a faithful formalization of the complete immutable Definition 2.7.5 selected by this task. No corrected-source or corpus-exclusion policy was supplied that would authorize dropping the literal K3/property-3 clause. The discrepancy therefore remains an explicit source finding rather than being silently repaired in favor of display (2.21).
resolved_items.primary_evidence: The source contract makes preservation of the printed property-3 wording an undebatable constraint and records that properties (c) and (d) are equivalent only up to an absolute factor, not by equality of their optimal parameters. The audit methodology states that a corrected-source theorem must not silently be counted faithful to a defective printed statement and that source validity requires a separate policy decision. The theorem itself states finite gauge iff some property has a positive witness; it does not state the missing optimal-K3 identity.

lean_implies_source.reasoning: Unfolding D001 and D004 gives the exact one-point infimum in display (2.21), and the target then asserts only that this gauge is finite exactly when one of D013/D014/D005/D007 has a positive scale. It does not imply the full printed definition's separate exact claim that the psi_1 norm is the smallest K3 satisfying property (c). D005 and D007 are deliberately distinct, and their optimal constants can differ (already for a positive constant random variable), so the missing quantitative clause cannot be recovered by definitional unfolding or by absolute-factor equivalence.

source_implies_lean.reasoning: The printed source includes both the display-(2.21) infimum and the assertion that properties (a)--(d) are equivalent up to an absolute factor. Hence satisfying any one property supplies a positive property-(d) scale and makes the displayed gauge finite; conversely a finite displayed gauge supplies a positive one-point scale and therefore property (d). The exact but discrepant K3/property-3 clause adds quantitative content but does not invalidate this class-membership/finiteness consequence.

remaining_uncertainties: The cited immutable source does not determine whether 'smallest K3 in property 3' or the immediately following display (2.21) reflects the author's intended exact norm definition. This unresolved authorial intent does not change the literal-source implication pair; treating display (2.21) as a correction would require a separate, explicit corpus policy.

findings.evidence: Definition 2.7.5 literally calls the norm the smallest K3 in property 3, but Proposition 2.7.1(c) is the all-lambda absolute-MGF condition with K3, while display (2.21) is the one-point condition of Proposition 2.7.1(d), whose parameter is K4. The two optimal constants are related only up to an absolute factor and need not be equal.
findings.impact: The formal display-based gauge cannot be counted as representing both consecutive printed numerical prescriptions. The defect must remain visible and requires an explicit corrected-source or corpus-exclusion policy if the display is to govern a different benchmark.

findings.evidence: D001/D004 encode the display-(2.21) infimum, but the audited proposition uses that quantity only in PsiOneGauge < top and equates finiteness with existence of any one of the four property witnesses. It contains no equality identifying the norm with the optimal property-(c) K3.
findings.impact: The wrapper preserves the qualitative sub-exponential class and the display-based finiteness characterization, but not every quantitative conclusion in the full printed definition; this yields Lean-implies-source no and not-faithful-weaker.

findings.evidence: D001/D004 exactly use an infimum of positive finite scales satisfying E exp(|X|/t) <= 2, and D002 dispatches separately to source properties (a)--(d), including distinct D005 property (c) and D007 property (d).
findings.impact: The declaration remains a sound and useful wrapper for the display-(2.21) convention and sub-exponential membership, even though this audit cannot accept it as the complete literal Definition 2.7.5.

findings.evidence: The prose says 'smallest,' while display (2.21) uses an infimum and supplies no attainment claim; D001 is sInf and the target asserts only finiteness.
findings.impact: The formal wrapper does not add a minimum-attainment requirement and faithfully follows the display on this boundary issue.

rationale: Adjudication is against the complete selected book definition, not against a silently corrected intended version. The Lean semantic closure accurately represents display (2.21), all four properties, their positive parameters, and the resulting nonvacuous finiteness/class-membership equivalence. However, the immutable source also literally assigns the exact psi_1 norm role to the smallest K3 of property 3, whereas the formal gauge uses the distinct property-(d) one-point scales. Since optimal property-(c) and property-(d) constants need not coincide, a finiteness equivalence using the latter cannot imply the full printed quantitative definition. The full source does imply the wrapper, so the required directions are no/yes, classification not-faithful-weaker, and acceptance false. The source discrepancy is preserved as a critical finding; the display-aligned wrapper's mathematical usefulness is recorded separately from faithfulness acceptance.
